title: Selectively shared condensed data for efficient federated learning

pse.problem: Excessive energy consumption due to overfitting problems caused by the use of redundant and duplicative condensed data during federated machine learning model training.
pse.solution_function: Selects and distributes a subset of diverse condensed datasets to multiple client devices for training their respective local models, reducing duplicative training and energy consumption.
pse.solution_structure: A central computing system, plurality of client devices, machine learning model parameters (weights, activation function parameters, biases), condensed datasets.
pse.solution_implementation: Client devices receive machine learning model parameters, perform data condensation operations on their respective local data to generate condensed datasets. The central system selects a subset of condensed datasets based on feature space distance, and sends the selected subset to client devices for training their respective local models.
pse.effect: Improved energy efficiency by reducing duplicative training in lower-resource computing environments.
